x: By the time they reached the steep hill after two miles Gary was controlling the race from the front with Dave Taylor of Herne Hill, not long out of hospital, struggling to keep in contact.

After the charge around the playing fields Herne Hill's Dave Taylor had already made his intentions plain. A few yards behind came Solly, Staines and a knot of Hounslow boys at the head of a bunch that included half a dozen claret and gold vests.

This year, however, the evening was enlivened by a super race from Ray Foley in the 3000 metres where he decimated his previous best by sticking to Herne Hill's (and Blackheath's) Dave Taylor like a limpet until with 600 metres remaining he just had to let go.
